student_summary.status_message: This representative applicant meets the implemented minimum requirements and has an application score of 8.5/10. That score is at or above the published 2025-entry historical minimum of 7.236, so the card returns Strong Choice historical guidance only. It does not predict or guarantee an interview or offer.
key_points: The GCSE and predicted A-level profile meets the implemented Home standard minimum requirements.
The seven GCSEs produce 24 raw points and a scaled GCSE component of 4.5/4.5.
The applicant is not contextual, so the contextual component is 0/1.5.
The 2025-entry Home standard minimum application score of 7.236 is historical guidance only, not a current cut-off.
SJT is ignored for eligibility and interview selection; Band 4 is not an automatic pre-interview rejection.
